title: 第六百零九章 拜见弩雅大长老第六百零八章 化身晋级
lines: 【看书领红包】关注公..众号【书友大本营】，看书抽最高888现金红包！
加菲昨天被挑战了五次，为了保住位置可谓是费尽了力气，累得一下班就回宿舍倒头就睡，也就错过了吴辉“被送礼”的环节。
今早听说后，他觉得颇为遗憾，所以才一大早过来找吴辉，准备趁着还没上班，补上昨天那一声恭喜。
谁能想到，这才一晚上过去，好兄弟居然就晋级了？！
要不要这么刺激？！
“这有什么好大惊小怪的？”吴辉瞥了他一眼，“血脉深度觉醒对体质本来就有洗练效果，几次下来，我的等级本来就已经达到了十一级巅峰。一瓶星辰露下去，自然就晋升了。”
“你说得倒是轻巧。”加菲苦笑不已。
服用星辰露的确可以增强体质，加快晋级。可想要晋级成功，前提是他已经将体内的血脉之力梳理平顺，并将之全部纳入了自己的掌控之中。否则，服用星辰露就不是加快晋级，而是自取灭亡了。
作为同样觉醒过血脉之力的星空巨人，加菲对于血脉之力这玩意有多暴躁，多难控制，可是深有感悟。
换了别人，谁能在一夜之间控制住暴涨的血脉之力？
酷瓦这家伙，还真是……
哎~算了~天才哪能理解他们这种普通人的困扰？看在兄弟的面子上，他就不吐槽了。
加菲这么想的时候，却没想过，他本人在很多普通星空巨人的眼里，同样也是天才级别的人物。
说话间，两人就已经进了黄昏大殿。
值班表昨天下班前就已经排好交上去了，吴辉和加菲今天都不站岗，只需要等候传唤就可以了。
因此，他们一进内殿，就直接去了专门提供给贴身侍卫们休息的偏殿。
两人到的不算早，殿内早就已经坐了两三个贴身侍卫，这会儿正随意地凑在一起喝茶聊天。
见吴辉进来，几人忙站起身，朝他恭敬行礼。
“见过队长。”
“不必客气，都坐吧。”
吴辉摆了摆手，就带着加菲走过去，坐到了他们旁边，加入了喝茶聊天的队伍。
见吴辉一点架子都没有，那几个贴身侍卫也放松下来，给吴辉斟了杯茶，就继续聊起天来。
他们之前正聊到莫琳侍从官和纳特元帅之间的八卦。加菲对这种八卦消息最感兴趣了，几乎是瞬间就融入了进去，兴致勃勃地跟他们一起八卦起来。
吴辉是真的没想到，这帮巨人明明一个个都长得那么魁梧彪悍，私下里居然都是些八卦精。
他之前还以为加菲是个个例呢~
而且，这帮人还不是单纯的八卦，而是相当的有考据精神，每一个消息都说的有理有据，甚至还有人证，物证，和旁证，听起来异常真实。
吴辉都快被他们给说服，觉得他们说的就是事实了。
可问题是，那能是事实吗？
说什么莫琳侍从官之所以这么多年都没有嫁人，其实是因为对纳特元帅一见钟情，几万年前就发了誓，非纳特元帅不嫁。
而纳特元帅其实也喜欢莫琳侍从官，只是因为莫琳侍从官是笛卡尔家族的女儿，纳特家族和迪卡尔家族之间又矛盾重重，这才强忍心痛拒绝了她。
但他又不愿意娶其他不喜欢的女人，这才单身至今。
听听，这都是些什么跟什么？
这充满了浓浓的狗血言情网络小说味道的故事，一听就是瞎编的，怎么可能是事实呢？
一帮人正说的热闹，忽然，几个老牌贴身侍卫都不约而同地闭上了嘴巴，换上了一副仿佛随时都处于戒备状态的严肃正经表情。
加菲还没反应过来，一脸莫名其妙，就见吴辉朝他使了个眼色。
他愣了愣，然后下意识地也板起了脸。
在这之后，没几秒的功夫，一道婀娜的人影就出现在了门外。
那人影一头披肩的黑长直，容貌精致，气度斐然，不是莫琳侍从官是谁？
加菲顿时被吓出了一头冷汗。
他这闭嘴得要是再晚一点，岂不就要被莫琳侍从官抓个正着了？
“侍从官大人。”
那几个老牌贴身护卫却像是刚刚才发现莫琳侍从官似的，一个个忙不迭地站起来朝她行礼，严肃正经得跟之前简直判若两人。
吴辉也跟着站了起来，朝她拱了拱手：“侍从官大人，可是陛下有什么吩咐？”
“酷瓦队长。”莫琳侍从官保持着优雅的仪态，朝吴辉微微欠了欠身，“陛下口谕，半小时后她将前往祖地拜见大长老，请酷瓦队长做好随行护卫的准备。”

Garfield was challenged five times yesterday. He tried his best to keep his position. He was so tired that he went back to the dormitory and fell asleep as soon as he got off work, thus missing the part where Wu Hui was given gifts.
After hearing about it this morning, he felt quite sorry, so he came over to see Wu Hui early in the morning, planning to make up for the congratulations he gave yesterday before he went to work.
Who would have thought that after just one night, the good brothers would advance? !
Do you want it to be so exciting? !
"What's all the fuss about?" Wu Hui glanced at him, "The deep awakening of the bloodline has a refining effect on the physique. After a few times, my level has already reached the peak of the eleventh level. After a bottle of star dew, I will naturally be promoted."
"You put it lightly." Garfield smiled bitterly.
Taking Star Dew can indeed enhance your physical fitness and speed up your promotion. But if he wants to be promoted successfully, the premise is that he has smoothed out the power of blood in his body and brought it all under his control. Otherwise, taking Star Dew will not speed up the promotion, but will lead to self-destruction.
As a star giant who has also awakened the power of blood, Garfield has a deep understanding of how violent and difficult to control the power of blood.
If it had been anyone else, who could have controlled the surge in bloodline power overnight?
This guy Kuwa is really...
Oh~ forget it~ How can a genius understand the troubles of ordinary people like them? For the sake of his brother, he stopped complaining.
When Garfield thought this, he never thought that he himself was also a genius in the eyes of many ordinary star giants.
While talking, the two of them had already entered the Dusk Hall.
The duty list had been prepared and handed in before get off work yesterday. Wu Hui and Garfield were not on duty today and only had to wait for the summons.
Therefore, as soon as they entered the inner hall, they went directly to the side hall specially provided for the personal guards to rest.
The two of them arrived not too early, and there were already two or three personal guards sitting in the hall, and they were casually drinking tea and chatting together.
Seeing Wu Hui come in, several people quickly stood up and saluted him respectfully.
"Meet the captain."
"You're welcome, please sit down."
Wu Hui waved his hand, walked over with Garfield, sat next to them, and joined the team drinking tea and chatting.
Seeing that Wu Hui had no airs at all, the personal guards also relaxed, poured Wu Hui a cup of tea, and continued chatting.
They were chatting about the gossip between Squire Maureen and Marshal Nut. Garfield was most interested in this kind of gossip. He got involved almost instantly and started gossiping with them with great interest.
Wu Hui really didn't expect that these giants were all so tall and tough, but secretly they were all gossips.
He thought Garfield was an exception before~
Moreover, this group of people is not just gossip, but is very research-oriented. Every piece of information they tell is well-founded and there are even witnesses, physical evidence, and circumstantial evidence, which sounds extremely real.
Wu Hui was almost convinced by them and felt that what they said was the truth.
But the question is, can that be true?
The reason why Attendant Maureen has not married for so many years is actually because she fell in love with Marshal Nat at first sight, and she swore an oath tens of thousands of years ago not to marry anyone other than Marshal Nat.
In fact, Marshal Nat also likes Attendant Maureen, but because Attendant Maureen is the daughter of the Descartes family, and there are many conflicts between the Nat family and the Descartes family, he suppressed his heartache and rejected her.
But he doesn't want to marry another woman he doesn't like, so he has been single ever since.
Listen, what are these?
This story, which is full of the flavor of a gory romance online novel, sounds like it is made up. How could it be true?
A group of people were talking lively when suddenly, several veteran personal guards closed their mouths in unison and put on serious expressions as if they were on alert at any time.
Before Garfield could react, with a baffled look on his face, he saw Wu Hui wink at him.
He was stunned for a moment, and then subconsciously he also straightened his face.
After that, within a few seconds, a graceful figure appeared outside the door.
That figure has long, straight black hair and a shawl, delicate appearance, and impressive bearing. Who is it if it's not the Attendant Maureen?
Garfield was suddenly frightened and broke into a cold sweat.
If he had shut up a little later, wouldn't he have been caught by Attendant Maureen?
"Your Majesty the Attendant."
The old personal guards seemed to have just discovered Attendant Maureen. They stood up and saluted her one by one, so serious and solemn that they were completely different from before.
Wu Hui also stood up and cupped his hands towards her: "Your Majesty, your Majesty, what are your orders?"
"Captain Kuwa." Attendant Maureen maintained an elegant manner and bowed slightly towards Wu Hui, "Your Majesty ordered that she will go to the ancestral land to meet the great elder in half an hour. Please prepare Captain Kuwa to accompany her as a escort."
